summary: We are looking for a talented intern to assist in building IoT systems with sensors, controllers, gateways, and cloud platforms.
responsibilities: Assist in building IoT systems with sensors, controllers, gateways, and cloud platforms.
Help integrate and test sensors (temperature, vibration, power, etc.) and communication modules like MQTT, Modbus, CAN, RS485, and Wi-Fi.
Support firmware development, embedded coding, and troubleshooting for IoT devices.
Assist in creating cloud dashboards for monitoring, alerts, and data insights.
Prepare simple documentation and collaborate with the engineering team on IoT projects.
